Name: (AT) Too Many Chickens
Author: Campaigner
Description:
This mod does a very simple thing; it adds 18 variants of each chicken. They follow a similar naming scheme, and do the following:
- "Normal" is a recolor of the default white and brown chicken.
  - These variants are included because I personally had a Content Patcher mod with no AT variant that replaced the default skins.
- "Grumpy" is a recolor of the void chicken.
- "Fabulous" is a recolor of the blue chicken.
- "Plump" is a recolor of the golden chicken.
- "Swift" is a recolor of the Speed Rooster from the Desert Festival.
- A color variant using another animal or object from the game. What is referenced will be explained by the first entry below.
- "Duck" versions have green combs and grey-brown feathers.
- "Travel" versions are purple with dark brown combs. Optional blue glasses as well.
- "Normal Speed Rooster" variant that uses Speed Rooster's colors on the current chicken appearance.
- "True Speed Rooster" variant that is literally just Speed Rooster.

Why does each chicken variant have duplicate skins, you may ask? Because maybe you will decide at some point "I kind of don't want a void chicken right now", or "this golden chicken is too gaudy for me", so you have an option for each color of chicken to just use one of the variants. More options never hurt!
